[[File:Wadim Zudilin.jpg|thumb|220px|Wadim Zudilin]]
'''Wadim Zudilin''' (Вадим Валентинович Зудилин) is a Russian [[mathematician]] and [[number theory|number theorist]] who is active in studying [[Hypergeometric series|hypergeometric functions]] and [[zeta constants]]. He studied under [[Yuri Valentinovich Nesterenko|Yuri V. Nesterenko]] and worked at [[Moscow State University]], the [[Steklov Institute of Mathematics]], the [[Max Planck Institute for Mathematics]] and the [[University of Newcastle, Australia]]. He works at [[Radboud University Nijmegen]] in the Netherlands.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ru.nl/en/people/zudilin-v|title=Prof. V. Zudilin (Wadim)|publisher=Radboud University Nijmegen|work=People|access-date=22 July 2025}}</ref>

He has reproved [[Apéry's theorem]] that {{math|''ζ''(3)}} is irrational, and expanded it. Zudilin proved that at least one of the four numbers {{math|''ζ''(5)}}, {{math|''ζ''(7)}}, {{math|''ζ''(9)}}, or {{math|''ζ''(11)}} is irrational.<ref>{{cite journal |author=W. Zudilin |title=One of the numbers ζ(5), ζ(7), ζ(9), ζ(11) is irrational |journal=Russ. Math. Surv. |year=2001 |volume=56 |issue=4 |pages=774–776 |doi=10.1070/RM2001v056n04ABEH000427|bibcode=2001RuMaS..56..774Z |s2cid=250734661 }}</ref> For that accomplishment, he won the Distinguished Award of the [[G. H. Hardy|Hardy]]-[[Srinivasa Ramanujan|Ramanujan]] Society in 2001.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://hrj.episciences.org/public/volumes/35/24Announcements.pdf|title = Announcements - Distinguished Awards}}</ref>

With [[Doron Zeilberger]], Zudilin<ref name="Zeilberger Zudilin">{{cite journal|last1=Zeilberger|first1=Doron|last2=Zudilin|first2=Wadim|date=7 January 2020|title=The irrationality measure of ''π'' is at most 7.103205334137…|journal=Moscow Journal of Combinatorics and Number Theory|volume=9|issue=4|pages=407–419|doi=10.2140/moscow.2020.9.407|arxiv=1912.06345|s2cid=209370638}}</ref> improved the known upper bound of the [[irrationality measure]] for {{pi}}, which as of November 2022 is the current best estimate.
